biotools.summary: The N3C PPRL resource links medical imaging data from TCIA, genomic variants from GenBank, and electronic health records from the National Clinical Cohort Collaborative using Privacy Preserving Record Linkage. This process enables integrative research on COVID-19 detection, diagnosis, and treatment.
